CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO ratios_asof(d) AS TABLE 
    WITH c AS (
        WITH ms AS (SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS session_date),
        ltype AS (SELECT security_id, mode(finra_type) AS line_type FROM read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/security_master/finra_names.parquet') GROUP BY 1),
        lk AS (SELECT m.session_date, l.security_id, l.cik, l.link_tier, l.linkprim
               FROM ms m JOIN read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/identity/link_table_v3.parquet') l
                 ON m.session_date BETWEEN l.valid_from AND coalesce(l.valid_to, DATE '2100-01-01')
               LEFT JOIN ltype t ON t.security_id = l.security_id
               WHERE l.link_tier IN ('strict', 'dated', 'name') AND l.linkprim IN ('P', 'J') AND l.cik IS NOT NULL
                 AND l.available_at <= CAST(m.session_date AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL 22 HOUR
                 AND coalesce(t.line_type NOT IN ('preferred', 'warrant', 'unit', 'right', 'note', 'ETF', 'ETN', 'fund'), true)),
        px AS (SELECT p.session_date, p.security_id, p.close AS prc FROM read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/prices/year=*/prices.parquet', union_by_name = true) p
               WHERE p.session_date IN (SELECT session_date FROM ms) AND p.close > 0),
        sh AS (SELECT s.session_date, s.security_id, s.shrout FROM read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/market/shares_daily/year=*/shares_daily.parquet', union_by_name = true) s
               WHERE s.session_date IN (SELECT session_date FROM ms)),
        c0 AS (SELECT lk.*, px.prc, sh.shrout, sh.shrout * px.prc AS me_line
               FROM lk JOIN px USING (session_date, security_id) LEFT JOIN sh USING (session_date, security_id))
        SELECT c0.*,
               CASE WHEN count(*) OVER w = count(me_line) OVER w THEN sum(me_line) OVER w END AS me,
               count(*) OVER w AS me_lines,
               (SELECT CAST(max(session_date) AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL 22 HOUR FROM read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/calendar.parquet') WHERE session_date < CAST(d AS DATE)) AS cutoff,
               CAST(session_date AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL 22 HOUR AS cutoff_clock
        FROM c0 WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY session_date, cik)),
    s AS (SELECT c.*, st.* EXCLUDE (cik, available_at), st.available_at AS fund_available_at
          FROM c ASOF LEFT JOIN read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/ratios/fund_state.parquet') st ON st.cik = c.cik AND c.cutoff > st.available_at),
    k AS (SELECT s.*, exp(-(CASE WHEN s.basis_date IS NULL THEN 0
                                 ELSE coalesce(sd.cum_lr, 0) - coalesce(sbas.cum_lr, 0) END)) AS eps_adj
          FROM s ASOF LEFT JOIN read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/ratios/split_events.parquet') sd ON sd.cik = s.cik AND s.session_date >= sd.ex_date
                 ASOF LEFT JOIN read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/ratios/split_events.parquet') sbas ON sbas.cik = s.cik AND s.basis_date >= sbas.ex_date),
    x AS (SELECT *, date_diff('day', datadate, session_date) AS staleness_days,
                 coalesce(date_diff('day', datadate, session_date)
                          <= CASE WHEN form0 IN ('20-F', '20-F/A', '40-F', '40-F/A') THEN 550 ELSE 400 END,
                          false) AS fresh_q,
                 coalesce(date_diff('day', fy0_datadate, session_date) <= 550, false) AS fresh_a,
                 me + ev_debt AS ev
          FROM k)
    SELECT session_date, security_id, cik, link_tier, linkprim, prc, shrout, me_line, me, me_lines, eps_adj, fund_available_at, datadate, fqtr, form0, ttm_src, ttm_fy0_items, fy0_datadate, first_datadate, hist_days, fin_template, sic, curcd, fx_converted, absent_items, be_q0, ev, staleness_days, fresh_q, fresh_a,
           CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN CASE WHEN (ni_avg5) <> 0 THEN (me) / (ni_avg5) END END AS capei, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (me) <> 0 THEN (be_q0) / (me) END END AS bm, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (oibdp_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me + ev_debt) / (oibdp_ttm) END END AS evm, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (ib_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me) / (ib_ttm) END END AS pe_issuer_ib, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (ni_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me) / (ni_ttm) END END AS pe_issuer_ni, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) END AS pe_exi, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) END AS pe_inc, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (sale_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me) / (sale_ttm) END END AS ps, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (oancf_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me) / (oancf_ttm) END END AS pcf, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN dpr END AS dpr, CASE WHEN (fresh_q AND fresh_a) THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) END AS peg_trailing, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (me) <> 0 THEN (dvc_ttm) / (me) END END AS divyield_paid, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE aftret_invcapx END AS aftret_invcapx, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN aftret_equity END AS aftret_equity, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN pretret_noa END AS pretret_noa, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN pretret_earnat END AS            CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_roa END AS f_roa, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_cfo END AS f_cfo, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_droa END AS f_droa, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_accrual END AS f_accrual, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_dlever END AS f_dlever, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_dliquid END AS f_dliquid, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_eqoff END AS f_eqoff, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_dmargin END AS f_dmargin, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_dturn END AS f_dturn, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_dsri END AS m_dsri, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_gmi END AS m_gmi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_aqi END AS m_aqi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_sgi END AS m_sgi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_depi END AS m_depi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_sgai END AS m_sgai, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_lvgi END AS m_lvgi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_tata END AS m_tata,
           nullif(concat_ws(',', CASE WHEN fresh_a AND ((ni_avg5) = 0 OR coalesce(((fy0_datadate IS NULL AND date_diff('day', first_datadate, datadate) < 300) OR hist_days < 1431), false)) THEN
